policy: Documentation-level verification only. Source access never establishes permission or runtime acceptance.

sources.title: Alpaca Market Data plans
sources.supports: Individual Basic lists IEX-only stocks, 30 stock streams, 200 historical requests/minute, indicative options. Individual and business arrangements differ.
sources.limitation: Provider/runtime/rights testing still required.

sources.title: Alpaca feed semantics
sources.supports: Historical feed selection is explicit; free SIP history requires end at least 15 minutes old. Subscription-default feed selection can change.
sources.limitation: No assumption of consolidated live quotes in the free mode.

sources.title: Alpaca paper environment
sources.supports: Paper simulation omits important real execution effects. Paper-only access is a candidate for free onboarding.
sources.limitation: Our simulator must declare its own economics; paper results are not proof of real performance.

sources.title: SnapTrade broker access
sources.supports: Broker guide lists supported integration routes, with production access requirements.
sources.limitation: Test each broker, account type, auth method, deployment and field; names on a list are not acceptance evidence.

sources.title: SnapTrade trade detection
sources.supports: Wealthsimple and Questrade trade detection is documented at five-minute-or-longer intervals.
sources.limitation: Account-state freshness must be separate from quote and processing latency.

sources.title: Questrade API
sources.supports: Personal users can access account/market information; API trade execution is limited to partner developers.
sources.limitation: Read-only capabilities only; company integration permission is a separate gate.

sources.title: IBKR Web API
sources.supports: Read-only portfolio subset exists. Third-party vendor integration requires approval and a distinct authentication process.
sources.limitation: No unattended commercial or local auth route assumed from a personal login.

sources.title: Wealthsimple activity export
sources.supports: Activity CSV download is documented.
sources.limitation: Real anonymized samples and corporate-action reconciliation are not yet tested.

sources.title: Yahoo portfolio CSV
sources.verification: Official search excerpt only; direct open failed
sources.supports: Yahoo help describes portfolio/list CSV transfer.
sources.limitation: Exact current columns, round-trip loss and transaction completeness remain sample-based qualification gates. Not a Yahoo market data license.

sources.title: SEC EDGAR APIs
sources.supports: SEC provides submissions and XBRL APIs.
sources.limitation: Respect fair-access rules; publication dates, units and restatements require normalization. No analyst-consensus promise.

sources.title: Bank of Canada Valet
sources.supports: Valet has no usage charge, registration or access-key requirement; daily data can be cached.
sources.limitation: Reference FX, not an executable conversion quote; respect terms and data timing.

sources.title: ChatGPT plan in other apps
sources.supports: Plan-funded requests are available in participating apps/tools subject to eligibility and plan rules.
sources.limitation: App participation, deployment and permissible financial use must be qualified; no universal subscription API.

sources.title: Claude Code authentication rules
sources.supports: Native unmodified Claude Code authentication is distinguished from prohibited collection/intermediation of Claude.ai credentials by third parties.
sources.limitation: Use API keys or approved native flow; no session-token proxy. Hosted feasibility remains open.

sources.title: xAI API authentication
sources.supports: API keys authenticate inference requests as bearer credentials.
sources.limitation: API adapter required; consumer-subscription access is not promised.

sources.title: PostgreSQL row security
sources.supports: Superusers, BYPASSRLS roles and ordinarily table owners can bypass row security.
sources.limitation: Use nonowner/nonbypass service roles and explicit isolation tests; RLS alone is insufficient.

sources.title: gVisor overview
sources.supports: gVisor provides an application-kernel isolation approach integrated with container execution.
sources.limitation: Chosen Linux sandbox qualification target, not proof of sufficient security or universal host compatibility.

sources.title: BCSC securities fundamentals
sources.supports: Being in the business of advising about securities can engage registration requirements, subject to applicable exemptions.
sources.limitation: Counsel must classify this actual non-discretionary product per jurisdiction. A disclaimer is not clearance.

sources.title: SEC investor bulletin on robo-advisers
sources.supports: Automated investment advice has securities-law considerations, including SEC/state adviser frameworks.
sources.limitation: Not a product-specific determination; map federal and relevant state obligations with counsel.

sources.title: FINRA stop-order risks
sources.supports: A stop trigger does not guarantee the execution price, and stop-limit orders may not execute.
sources.limitation: Planned stop loss is a scenario, not guaranteed maximum loss.

sources.title: OIC assignment
sources.supports: American-style short options can be assigned before expiry.
sources.limitation: Separate expiration payoff from pathwise collateral, assignment and settlement risk.

sources.title: OIC vertical put spreads
sources.supports: Vertical-spread analysis includes early-assignment and financing consequences, not merely an expiry payoff.
sources.limitation: Do not model a spread as an inseparable atomic position throughout its life.

sources.title: Probability of Backtest Overfitting
sources.supports: Bailey, Borwein, Lopez de Prado and Zhu discuss selection-related backtest overfitting and a diagnostic framework.
sources.limitation: Diagnostics inform research; no universal test proves a trading edge.

sources.title: Apache License 2.0
sources.supports: Chosen project license. Dependencies, datasets, prompts and model terms still require separate compatibility review.
sources.limitation: Copyright ownership/contributor policy must be finalized before public publication.

sources.title: Codex AGENTS.md
sources.supports: AGENTS.md provides repository instructions with discovery/precedence rules.
sources.limitation: Verify actual client version and applicable instructions in the target repository.

sources.title: Codex execution plans
sources.supports: Persistent execution plans can specify goals, steps and verification evidence for longer work.
sources.limitation: This bundle supplies its own bounded task contracts; no external plugin is required.

sources.title: Existing user AC/ECC compatibility guide
sources.supports: Existing guide uses AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and a shared .agentic state; configured checks must not be overwritten.
sources.limitation: This bundle is an original project-specific handoff, not the ECC distribution or an installer.
